svg.title: fig02
svg.desc: Figure 2 | Where computational work is reduced in the DANCeRS architecture. (a) A conceptual two-robot diagram shows planning and global-consensus graph fragments, each with open circular variables and square factors. Graph edges are schematic and do not represent sampled communication topology. Dashed purple arrows denote information exchange. Numbered markers identify (1) contiguous KD-tree positions and identifiers, (2) reuse of exactly unchanged neighbour topology, (3) GBP snapshot/copy/solve reuse, (4) scalar R1 information operations with identity-transport bypass, and (5) single-owner movement of externally staged messages. (b) The retained sensing, GBP, and motion cycle. The implementation preserves the GBP schedule, internal sweep count, update order, convergence settings, and reported planner metrics. CSV coordinates are diagram-layout data, not experimental measurements.
